title: Migration 52 — COA multi-report grouping
description: Applies migrations 24 and 28 as prerequisites (52 extends 28's document_field_extractions and recuts its record_document_field_extraction write path; 28 in turn constrains 24's attachment table), then migration 52. VERIFY A checks the catalogue shape including the absence of the stale 7-argument overload; B writes a two-report pack through the RPC interleaved and proves the reports read back apart, which is the defect migration 52 exists to close; C-E prove the new constraints refuse what they claim while still permitting migration-28-shaped rows; F re-proves append-only; G re-proves the admin gate survived the DROP/CREATE; H counts rows so no swallowed refusal can pass unnoticed. Rollback restores the 7-argument function and drops the grouping columns.

verify.note: A is catalogue shape, signature uniqueness and ACL. B is the headline: a two-report pack must not merge. C bounds report_ordinal at 1. D refuses a label with no ordinal. E proves the adjacent legitimate cases (NULL ordinal, and migration 28 §3.5's absent-value-needs-warning) still behave. F is append-only. G is the admin gate after the function recreate, including the session-less case a service-role connection presents. H is a row count that catches a refusal which wrote anyway.
